class ProviderEvidence:
    ready: Any
    diagnostic: str | None

    @property
    def ready_bool(self) -> bool | None:
        """Strict readiness for consumers; `ready` retains legacy raw values."""
        return self.ready if isinstance(self.ready, bool) else None

def provider_evidence(
    payload: Any, provider: str, *, legacy_truthiness: bool = False, flat_legacy: bool = False
) -> ProviderEvidence:
    """Read explicit state first, then the documented old readiness maps.

    Unknown string states retain the old false verdict; diagnostics name the
    value. Malformed legacy values retain the caller's previous interpretation.
    """
    prefix = f"{PRODUCER}: "
    path = f"provider_states.{provider}"
    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        return ProviderEvidence(None, prefix + "$ missing/invalid object")
    states = payload.get("provider_states")
    state = states.get(provider) if isinstance(states, Mapping) else None
    issue = None
    if isinstance(state, Mapping):
        ready = state.get("ready")
        if isinstance(ready, bool):
            issue = None if ready else prefix + path + f".ready=false (kind={state.get('kind')!r})"
            return ProviderEvidence(ready, issue)
        label = state.get("state")
        if isinstance(label, str):
            issue = None if label == "ready" else prefix + path + f".state={label!r}"
            if label not in {"ready", "degraded", "not_ready"}:
                issue = prefix + path + f".state unrecognized {label!r}"
            return ProviderEvidence(label == "ready", issue)
        issue = prefix + path + ".ready missing/invalid boolean; .state missing/invalid string"
    elif isinstance(states, Mapping) and provider in states:
        issue = prefix + path + " invalid object"
    providers = payload.get("providers")
    if isinstance(providers, Mapping) and provider in providers:
        raw = providers[provider]
        ready = bool(raw) if legacy_truthiness else raw
        if not isinstance(raw, bool):
            issue = prefix + f"providers.{provider} invalid boolean {raw!r}"
        elif not raw:
            issue = issue or prefix + f"providers.{provider}=false"
        return ProviderEvidence(ready, issue)
    if flat_legacy and provider in payload:
        raw = payload[provider]
        return ProviderEvidence(
            bool(raw), None if raw is True else prefix + f"{provider}={raw!r} (legacy)"
        )
    disabled = payload.get("disabled_providers")
    if isinstance(disabled, list) and provider in disabled:
        issue = prefix + f"disabled_providers includes {provider!r}; {path} absent"
    return ProviderEvidence(None, issue or prefix + path + f" / providers.{provider} missing")
